title: HistoricalEventNoticeMessage
description: One historical record delivered to a player (ADR-0014 section 6). The history runner produces the record; the gateway/tick driver wraps it into this message (it alone knows the send tick, the message_id and whether the delivery is LIVE or BACKFILL). LIVE: sent after the history runner COMMITTED the record, to every open session allowed to see it. BACKFILL: sent when a session opens (after SESSION_READY), once per existing record that session may see, in ascending tick order. Never sent before commit. A session may receive the same record both as LIVE and as BACKFILL; the client shows it once, keyed by historical_event.historical_event_id (spec p1-02 I-65). The envelope tick is the gateway's current tick at send time, not the record's tick. Not a response to any command. Contains no sentence and no display name: the client builds the text. KNOWN EXPIRY: historical_event references MINERAL_DISCOVERED directly because it is the only historical type; the slice that adds the second historical type must turn this field into a discriminated union (schema_version 2 or a codegen extension).

delivery.description: LIVE = it just happened. BACKFILL = it happened before this session opened. Closed set.
